message_i18n.description: Translation key for the message, when one exists

details.description: Structured details for some errors. Nginx configuration errors use kind "nginx_config".

hint.example: Check the spelling of the directive.

hint_code.description: Names the hint, for clients that word it in their own language

area.description: Part of the host's config the error is in, eg. host_advanced

relative_line.description: Line within that area, eg. of the advanced configuration

reason.description: Set for special cases: conflict, regenerated_conflict, too_many_broken_hosts, redacted

detail.description: The humanised nginx error on its own, for clients that word the rest of the message themselves. kind unsafe_value: the rejected value, quoted

field.description: kind unsafe_value: which value can't be written into nginx config, eg. forward_host
